_differences in cottonwood/prospects.py adds a checklist.<key> pair for each incoming answer, comparing it with the stored checklist. It asserts exactly one line containing 'checklist.direct_signal differs', that the line contains 'kept stored' and "stored 'yes'" and "incoming 'no'", and that leads.checklist still equals '{"direct_signal": "yes"}'.
